description:
pkix-revocation/src/crl.rs:702-710

The pattern .map(|bc| bc.ca).unwrap_or(false) is the anti-idiomatic form of .is_some_and(|bc| bc.ca). Clippy pedantic catches this as 'called map(<f>).unwrap_or(false) on an Option value'. The same pattern exists in pkix-path/src/lib.rs cert_is_ca_cert equivalent.

is_some_and was stabilised in Rust 1.70; MSRV is 1.73, so it is available.

Suggested fix:
  cert.tbs_certificate
      .extensions
      .as_deref()
      .unwrap_or(&[])
      .iter()
      .find(|e| e.extn_id == OID_BASIC_CONSTRAINTS)
      .and_then(|e| BasicConstraints::from_der(e.extn_value.as_bytes()).ok())
      .is_some_and(|bc| bc.ca)
title: [rusty] cert_is_ca_cert: .map(|bc| bc.ca).unwrap_or(false) should be .is_some_and(|bc| bc.ca)
